items.text: Provide food and all necessaries for the children you have begotten.
items.quote: It is a most sacred law of nature that a father should provide food and all necessaries for those whom he has begotten.

items.text: Secure productive property and transmit it to your children by inheritance, so that they may be kept from want and misery.
items.quote: in no other way can a father effect this except by the ownership of productive property, which he can transmit to his children by inheritance.

items.text: Govern your household with the authority proper to a father.
items.quote: a true society, governed by an authority peculiar to itself, that is to say, by the authority of the father.

items.text: Keep your child under your power and charge until he attains the use of free will.
items.quote: before it attains the use of free will, under the power and the charge of its parents.

items.text: Obey your parents and remain under their charge until you attain the use of free will.
items.quote: before it attains the use of free will, under the power and the charge of its parents.
